meta_description: Compose a custom wedding crest in under a minute. Six styles, twelve layouts, eight typography pairings.
title: Create your wedding crest
description: Tell us about your day and we will compose a one-of-a-kind crest.
invalid_hex: Please enter a valid hex color (e.g. #a4b6a0)
personal_elements_hint: Add up to 2 personal details (e.g. a beloved pet, monogram, family crest).
personal_image_upload_hint: Upload up to 2 photos (a pet, a place, an object). We'll paint the main subject into your crest in the chosen style.
personal_image_max_reached: You can attach up to 2 reference photos.
personal_image_upload_error: Couldn't upload that photo. Try a JPG, PNG, or WEBP under 10MB.
preview_note: The illustration is a name-free background; the program adds names and date on top.
generate_hint: We will compose one crest for you.
submit_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
edit_description: Change anything from the create steps. We'll regenerate the crest with the new choices and keep your previous generations in history.
edit_load_error: Couldn't load your project. Head back to /my-designs and try again.
border_hint: Pick a frame from the studio library — or skip this to keep the crest borderless.
border_empty: No borders available for this style yet.
start_from_example_hint: Tap any crest to load its style, colors, and layout — you can swap your names in next.
